{"design":"# Plan: mimid-1wgh.2 — mimi-content (draft-ietf-mimi-content-09, CBOR)

Approved by Mark 2026-10-17. Checked against -09 text, WG examples repo tag draft-ietf-mimi-content-09 (commit a89298c8), and phnx-im/mimi-content. All 14 WG example MessageIds were independently recomputed (Python) and match under the -08/-09 length-prefixed §3.3 algorithm with the user URI as sender.

## Mark's decisions
- CBOR: minicbor =2.3.0 (BlueOak-1.0.0) approved. Hash: sha2 =0.11.1.
- WG example fixtures vendored under IETF TLP, noted in PROVENANCE.
- Strict: reject non-deterministically encoded input (D4).
- ExternalPart *type* in this crate; its encryption lives in mimid-1wgh.14 (no aes-gcm here). ULID senderMsgId derivation lives in the agent.

## 1. Type model (crates/mimi-content)
| CDDL | Rust |
|---|---|
| mimiContent (7-elem array) | MimiContent { salt: [u8;16], replaces: Option<MessageId>, topic_id: Vec<u8>, expires: Option<Expiration>, in_reply_to: Option<MessageId>, extensions: Extensions, body: NestedPart } |
| MessageId | MessageId([u8;32]) |
| Expiration | enum Expiration { Absolute(u32), Relative(u32) } |
| NestedPart | NestedPart { disposition: Disposition, language: String, part: Part } |
| part alternatives | enum Part { Null, Single{content_type, content}, External(ExternalPart), Multi{semantics, parts: Vec<NestedPart>} } |
| ExternalPart | flat struct, widths from .size |
| dispositions 0..255 | Disposition(u8) with named consts; 9..255 kept |
| part semantics | closed enum; unknown rejected (§9.1) |
| extensions | Extensions { sender_uri: Option<String>, room_uri: Option<String>, other: BTreeMap<ExtensionKey, RawValue> } |

Unknown extensions: ExtensionKey { Uint(u64), Nint(u64), Text(String) } with Ord = RFC 8949 §4.2.1 bytewise order. RawValue = exact bytes of one validated CBOR item, re-emitted verbatim; validation covers well-formedness, definite lengths, shortest form, sorted nested keys, key types, depth, NaN rule, UTF-8 (§6.2-6.3).
API: MimiContent::decode(&[u8]) -> Result<_, DecodeError> (strict); encode(&self) -> Result<Vec<u8>, EncodeError> (fallible: <2-part multipart, depth); MessageId::compute(sender_uri, room_uri, content_bytes, salt) hashes received bytes.
Out: MessageDerivedValues/Timestamp (protocol crate), part-index iterator, builders.

## 2. CBOR crate
| | minicbor | ciborium 0.2.2 | cbor4ii 1.2.3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Last release | 2026-07 | 2024-01 (stale) | 2026-09 |
| Shortest/definite | yes | yes | yes |
| Auto map sort | no (BTreeMap suffices) | CanonicalValue uses RFC 7049 length-first, forbidden by §6.1 | no |
| Positional access for raw capture | yes | no | limited |
| Group-choice-in-array shape | hand-written Encode/Decode | serde fights | serde fights |
phnx also uses minicbor (so phnx isn't independent at the codec layer).

## 3. Fixtures and oracles
crates/mimi-content/tests/fixtures/wg-09/: 14 examples as .cbor + .edn + .pretty (attachment, conferencing, delete, edit, expiring, mention, mention-html, multipart-1, multipart-2, multipart-3, original, reaction, reply, unlike), implied-original.*, mimi-content.cddl, implied.cddl, PROVENANCE (tag, commit SHA, URLs, per-file SHA-256, IETF TLP note). Exclude .edn/.pretty in _typos.toml.
| Test | Oracle |
|---|---|
| T1 decode->encode byte-identical, all 14 | WG .cbor |
| T2 encode hand-built structs (original, attachment, multipart-3) == fixture bytes | WG .cbor, decoder not involved |
| T3 computed MessageId == "# message ID" header in each .edn; sender/room from table copied from draft | WG-published IDs |
| T4 reply/edit/delete/unlike/reaction/mention reference fields == referenced example's ID | cross-example consistency |
| T5 negatives as hand-written hex (non-shortest, indefinite, unsorted/dup keys, key 1 not tstr, depth 5, 1-part multipart, cardinality 4, semantics 3, disposition 256, 15-byte salt, trailing bytes, bad UTF-8, non-canonical NaN) | spec rules |
| T6 unknown-extension message (keys 3, -1, "x", nested) round-trips | hand-written hex, accepted by cddl-rs |
| T7 all fixtures + encoder outputs validate | cddl =0.10.7 dev-dep (MIT, offline) |

## 4. Decision records (filed)
D1 MessageId URIs when ext 1/2 absent: caller passes authenticated values; agent checks ext 1/2 equal if present (else discard §9.1); sender = user URI. D2 hash received bytes. D3 contentHash covers ciphertext ("content at the target url"). D4 reject non-deterministic input. D5 NestedPart depth: root = level 1 (B.3 is 4 deep, accepted). D6 extension depth: maps, arrays, tags each count, extensions map included. D7 extension value: A.1 `any` (size limit removed per C.10). D8 url: tstr, no URI parsing. D9 draft §5.2/§5.3 hex dumps stale (-07 IDs 01b00844...); repo .cbor (017ce548...) is the fixture. D10 §5.3 prose U+2665 vs bytes U+2764: keep fixture bytes. D11 codec enforces part count (<=1024) and topicId (<=4096); agent enforces expiry. D12 extension key 0 kept as unknown.
Editorial only: §3.1/§5 say CDDL in "Appendix B" (it's A); §6.1 "RFC7094" for RFC 7049; EDN comments mislabel Pacific time as Z.

## 5. Risks
- phnx: structure reference only (uses -07 MessageId, stale IDs, hashes a re-encoding). AGPL; read, don't copy.
- cddl-rs may not handle the spliced group choice or .size on uint; T7 is a spike with a Ruby cddl fallback.
"}
